title: Introducing Pactory integration
summary: Blaxel is now officially integrated with Pactory, the AI Agents Marketplace!
body_text: Pactory is an AI Agents Marketplace that enables businesses and consumers to use AI agents to solve their tasks. It also allows agent developers to connect, distribute, and monetize their agents. Pactory provides agent developers with full billing, UI, and user management. Every agent gets a personal page that can be shared or discovered by marketplace users. Agent developers receive revenue share payments based on their agent's usage, with no hidden fees. With Blaxel , developers can create and deploy AI agents in any framework. It provides the dev tools to quickly bootstrap an agent template in Python or JS, and deploy it on a distributed serverless infrastructure. Now, any agent built and deployed with Blaxel can be easily connected using the agent endpoint and profile API key. A full tutorial on how to connect and monetize a Blaxel agent is available in the Blaxel documentation .

title: Pre-Existing Conditions in HMOs: All You Need to Know About PECs
summary: When it comes to choosing an HMO for your company, understanding the benefits is key to getting the right one— especially when it comes to Pre-Existing Conditions for your employees. Here's all you need to know about PECs before making your decision.
body_text: Why Do HMOs Check for Pre-Existing Conditions? HMOs in the Philippines conduct checks for pre-existing conditions primarily to manage risk and healthcare costs. These evaluations help insurers anticipate potential claims and maintain sustainability for all members. How Are Pre-Existing Conditions Evaluated? Health Questionnaires : Employees may be asked to fill out detailed forms about their medical history. Annual Physical Exams (APE) or Pre-Employment Medical Examinations (PME or PEME) : Results provide objective data about current health status. Doctor Assessments & Past Medical Records : Some plans may request reports to verify conditions. ALSO READ: HMO Glossary: All the Definitions You Need to Know for HMO Some HMOs may also ask for health declarations to ensure transparency. Accurate declarations protect employees from future claim denials and ensure the plan can provide the right support for their needs. Hive Health offers coverage of pre-existing conditions up to MBL from day one without requirements. Get a sample proposal here ! Are Pre-Existing Conditions Covered by HMOs? Coverage of pre-existing conditions varies depending on the HMO plan in the Philippines. Most plans offer partial coverage, full coverage after evaluation, or limited coverage depending on the condition and plan terms. Waiting Periods For some HMOs, pre-existing conditions may not be covered immediately. A waiting period is the time you must wait after enrollment before coverage for pre-existing conditions kicks in. In the Philippines, waiting periods typically range from 6 months to 2 years, depending on the type of condition and the HMO provider. Partial vs. Excluded Coverage Partially covered : Some conditions may be partially reimbursed or have caps or set limits during the waiting period. Excluded : Certain conditions may not be covered at all if they pose high risk. Coverage limits : Many HMOs may offer coverage once the condition is reviewed by a medical professional, but set a maximum reimbursement amount for chronic conditions. Maximum Benefit Limits (MBL) : Coverage may be limited up to the plan’s annual MBL. Understanding these nuances before choosing an HMO helps the HRs understand the coverage plan, and thus helps employees avoid surprises when filing for claims. HR teams should carefully review plan documents to understand these limits and communicate them clearly to employees. What Happens If You Don’t Declare a Pre-Existing Condition? Failing to declare a pre-existing condition can lead to consequences: Claims investigation : Insurers may review medical records and investigate discrepancies. Risks of non-disclosure : Denied claims, delayed reimbursements, or even plan cancellation. Honest disclosure is always the safest choice, especially when it comes to health. It ensures that employees receive the care they need and protects the company from liability. Tips for Employees and HR Teams When Choosing an HMO Plan Selecting the right HMO plan requires careful consideration. Here are some practical tips: Ask About Pre-Existing Coverage : Clarify which conditions are covered, waiting periods, and partial vs. full benefits. Compare Plans : Look at the maximum benefit limits, coverage inclusions, and all exclusions . Prioritize Digital Access : Platforms that offer teleconsultations and online LOAs save time and improve care management for employees with chronic conditions. Check Telehealth Options : Quick access to online doctors ensures employees get timely diagnosis, prescriptions, and care without long hospital waits. Consider Employee Needs : Evaluate which conditions are common in your workforce and choose plans that provide appropriate support. Modern HMOs like Hive Health make this process easier by giving HR teams a dashboard to track claims, LOAs, and coverage, while employees can schedule teleconsults and manage prescriptions — all from their phone or computer. title: Comparing Cloud-Gaming Controllers: Which One Offers the Best Value for Money?
summary: Find the best affordable Turtle Beach controller for cloud gaming. Compare budget-friendly options with Hall Effect sensors, low latency, and multi-plat...
body_text: Cloud gaming has exploded in popularity, with the market projected to grow from $5.32 billion in 2025 to $39.57 billion by 2030, according to Mordor Intelligence . As more gamers stream titles through Xbox Cloud Gaming, GeForce NOW, and PlayStation Remote Play. The answer isn't always the most expensive option. The real winners balance essential features with smart pricing. Whether you're streaming on your phone or grinding competitive matches on your tablet, value comes down to three factors: latency, durability, and versatility. Higher price tags don't guarantee better gameplay, especially when budget options now include Hall Effect sensors and customizable profiles. What Makes a Turtle Beach Controller Great Value for Cloud Gaming Price alone doesn't determine value. A $30 controller that drifts after three months wastes more money than a $100 option that lasts years. True value means getting features that actually improve your cloud gaming experience without paying for unnecessary extras. Latency matters most. Wired USB-C connections beat Bluetooth every time for shooters and racers, cutting input lag that can ruin competitive play. When you're already dealing with network latency from streaming, the last thing you need is additional controller delay. Hall Effect sensors are game-changers for durability. These magnetic sensors dramatically reduce stick drift because they use magnets rather than physical contact potentiometers. Turtle Beach controllers with Hall Effect technology now compete directly with premium options that lack this feature, offering lifetime protection against drift. Multi-platform compatibility extends your investment. The best value controllers work seamlessly across Xbox, PC, Android, and iOS. You shouldn't need separate controllers for your phone, tablet, and console. Controllers supporting multiple connection types (Bluetooth, 2.4GHz wireless, USB-C) give you flexibility without buying multiple devices. Build quality matters too. Controllers with anti-slip textures and comfortable grips feel better during marathon sessions. Cheap materials might save money upfront, but often lead to buyer's remorse. Budget Performance: Under $100 The budget tier has evolved dramatically with Turtle Beach's accessible options. You no longer have to sacrifice essential features for affordability. The Rematch Core Wired Controller stands out as an exceptional value. With responsive controls and solid build quality, it provides an accessible entry point for players building their first cloud gaming setup. The wired connection eliminates wireless latency concerns while keeping costs low. For enhanced visual appeal, the Afterglow Ignite Wired Controller adds customizable LED lighting without breaking the bank. Its transparent design and reliable performance make it perfect for casual cloud gamers who want style and substance. The Afterglow Wave Wired Controller delivers Xbox-optimized performance with wave-inspired aesthetics. For budget-conscious gamers streaming Xbox titles, this controller punches well above its weight class. Mid-Range Winners: $100-$150 Mid-range controllers occupy the sweet spot where features, build quality, and price align perfectly. The Stealth Pivot Controller introduces an innovative modular design that adapts to different game genres. With 20-hour battery life, Hall Effect anti-drift thumbsticks, and customization options like mappable buttons and adjustable trigger throw distance, the Stealth Pivot delivers professional-grade features at a competitive mid-range price. The Rematch Advanced Wired Controller bridges the gap between budget and premium with enhanced build quality and advanced features that competitive players demand. Mid-range options justify their cost through longevity and versatility. If you stream frequently or take cloud gaming seriously, investing in this tier prevents the need to upgrade later. Premium Options Worth Considering Premium controllers cost $150 and up. At this price, you're paying for pro-grade extras and deep customization. The Stealth Ultra Controller stands as one of the best pro controllers available, connecting to Xbox Series X/S wirelessly. It features anti-drift Hall Effect joysticks offering near-zero risk of drift. The Connected Command Display lets you control messaging apps, adjust EQ for wired headsets, remap buttons, and customize RGB lighting directly from the controller. With tactile mechanical switches and up to 30 hours of wireless usage, it delivers professional performance. The Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded Wireless Controller takes modular customization to another level with 11 interchangeable parts featuring Hall Effect technology. Four programmable buttons, trigger stops, and 20-hour battery life round out the professional features perfect for competitive cloud gaming. Premium controllers make sense for competitive gamers who need every advantage. For casual cloud gamers, a mid-range option often delivers 90% of the performance at 60% of the cost. Making Your Decision Choosing the best value controller depends on your specific needs and gaming habits. Define your primary use case. Mobile-only gamers streaming during commutes have different needs than multi-platform users. Match your controller's strengths to where you'll actually use it most often. Consider your game genres. Competitive shooters demand low latency and Hall Effect sensors. Fighting game fans benefit from responsive buttons and mechanical switches. RPG gamers can prioritize comfort and battery life over ultra-low latency. Upgrade Your Cloud Gaming Setup Ready to level up your cloud gaming experience? Turtle Beach offers controllers engineered for serious gamers who demand performance. The buying guide for trending gaming gifts helps identify the perfect combination of controllers and audio gear. Your ultimate couch gaming setup can extend seamlessly to mobile cloud gaming with Turtle Beach's versatile controller lineup. For audio decisions that complement your controller choice, should I stick with wired or try wireless gaming headsets explores how headset selection impacts your cloud gaming experience. Competitive fighting game specialists should explore leverless vs traditional fight sticks competitive play for specialized insights. The Victrix Pro KO elevates your fighting game performance with frame-perfect precision for tournament-level cloud gaming. Transform your cloud gaming experience with Turtle Beach controllers that deliver lasting value without sacrificing performance. FAQ What's the most important feature for cloud gaming controllers? Low latency matters most. Wired USB-C connections consistently outperform Bluetooth for competitive titles. Hall Effect sensors come second, preventing stick drift that ruins precision in shooters and racing games. Are expensive controllers always a better value? Higher prices don't guarantee better value. Many mid-range Turtle Beach controllers now include Hall Effect sensors and multi-platform support. Value depends on matching features to your needs. Competitive gamers benefit from premium features, while casual gamers often overpay for customization they'll never use. How long should a good controller last? Controllers with Hall Effect sensors should last 3-5 years of regular use without drift issues. Traditional sticks typically develop drift within 1-2 years of heavy use. Premium Turtle Beach controllers with reinforced shells outlast budget options with plastic construction.

body_text: HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc. Announces Completion of Previous Stock Repurchase Program and Authorization of New Stock Repurchase Program December 16, 2025 ASHEVILLE, N.C., Dec. 16, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: HTB), the holding company for HomeTrust Bank, announces the completion of its 5% stock repurchase program, which began in March 2022. A total of 806,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of $31.84 per share. In addition, the Company's Board of Directors has authorized the repurchase of up to an additional 870,000 shares of the Company’s common stock, representing approximately 5% of the Company’s currently outstanding shares. The shares may be purchased in the open market or in privately negotiated transactions from time to time depending upon market conditions and other factors. About HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc. HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: HTB), headquartered in Asheville, North Carolina, is the holding company for HomeTrust Bank, a state-chartered community bank operating over 30 locations across North Carolina, South Carolina, East Tennessee, Southwest Virginia, and Georgia. With total assets of $4.6 billion as of September 30, 2025, the Company’s goal is to continue to be recognized as a high-performing, regional community bank, while our strategy to reach that goal is to be a best place to work. As a reflection of these efforts, the Company has been named one of Bank Director’s “Best U.S. Banks,” one of Forbes’ “America’s Best Banks," one of S&P Global’s “Top 50 Community Banks," and named to the 2025 KBW Honor Roll. In addition, the Company has been recognized as one of American Banker’s “Best Banks to Work For," received a “Most Loved Workplace” certification by Best Practices Institute, named as one of Best Companies Group’s “America’s Best Workplaces," as well as being named a “Best Place to Work” in all five states in which the Company operates. body_text: Ellomay Capital Ltd. (the “ Company ”), hereby provides an update in connection with the claim filed with the Israeli District Court of Tel Aviv by Edelcom Ltd. (“ Edelcom ”), which holds 18.75% of the shares of Dorad Energy Ltd. (“ Dorad ”), against Dorad and its other shareholders, including Ellomay Luzon Energy Infrastructures Ltd. (a private company that is 50% owned by the Company and holds 33.75% of the shares of Dorad), in September 2024 (the “ Claim ”). As noted in the Company’s Form 6-K, submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “ SEC ”) on December 16, 2025, on December 15, 2025, Edelcom submitted a notice and request to the court, requesting the dismissal of the Claim following a preliminary hearing held on November 11, 2025, while reserving all of its claims and rights, including the right to file a new claim based on the same facts underlying the Claim. The Company hereby updates that on December 22, 2025, the court granted the request and dismissed Edelcom’s claim, stating that in the event Edelcom will commence a similar proceeding in the future, the defendants will be entitled to file a request for expenses in connection with the dismissed claim. For more information about the Claim see the Company’s Annual Report on Form 20-F submitted to the SEC on April 30, 2025, and the Form 6-K submitted by the Company to the SEC on December 1, 2025. Signatures Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned, thereunto duly authorized. Ellomay Capital Ltd. By: /s/ Ran Fridrich Ran Fridrich Chief Executive Officer and Director Dated: December 23, 2025
